sentences.en: The master of thrillers has left the scene forever.
sentences.zh: 惊悚小说大师永远离开了人世。

sentences.en: Michael Jackson's album Thriller is the best-selling album of all time.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·杰克逊的专辑《颤栗》是有史以来销量最高的专辑。

sentences.en: Jack's adventures are more amazing than those of the hero in many thrillers.
sentences.zh: 杰克的经历比许多惊悚片中的英雄经历更加令人惊叹。

senses.zh: 恐怖小说,使人毛骨悚然的东西,令人感到兴奋的事,（电影）惊悚片
